    m.addConstr(4.74 * vars['Var_2'] + 4.32 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.57 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.17 * vars['Var_6'] <= 129.06, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(7.38 * vars['Var_0'] + 1.85 * vars['Var_1'] + 1.05 * vars['Var_2'] + 3.0 * vars['Var_3'] + 2.31 * vars['Var_4'] + 9.25 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.69 * vars['Var_6'] + 9.16 * vars['Var_7'] <= 241.58, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(7.36 * vars['Var_0'] + 7.63 * vars['Var_1'] + 6.99 * vars['Var_6'] <= 121.48, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(5.27 * vars['Var_0'] + 3.41 * vars['Var_1'] + 5.11 * vars['Var_2'] + 5.02 * vars['Var_3'] + 6.94 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.42 * vars['Var_5'] + 4.58 * vars['Var_6'] <= 214.46, name='C7')
